maria: FYI we got a customer escalation — they're trying to stream responses from the rerank endpoint and getting errors + weird scores. pasted their curl below.

maria: ```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"query": "Which of these is about payment?", "documents": ["Invoice overdue", "New feature request", "Billing question"], "stream": true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```

maria: Response they see: HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type, body: "streaming not supported on rerank" and x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d

ajay: can you paste the exact request-id + headers? Also did they set Transfer-Encoding: chunked? rerank is sync — it shouldn't accept SSE.

maria: request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
maria: headers: User-Agent: acme-bot/1.2, Accept: text/event-stream, Content-Type: text/event-stream, Transfer-Encoding: chunked

maria: logs from ingress (redacted):
```
2026-02-18T14:22:10Z ingress: incoming req req_0a1b2c3d from 52.12.34.56
2026-02-18T14:22:10Z middleware:sse-check: found Accept=text/event-stream -> reject
2026-02-18T14:22:10Z rerank: handler aborted, unsupported content-type text/event-stream, code=415
```

sam: this is expected: rerank endpoint doesn't support streaming or chunked SSE. The middleware that handles SSE sees Accept: text/event-stream and expects SSE semantics; Content-Type text/event-stream makes our body parsing hit the wrong decoder and we return 415. The "weird scores" part probably comes from malformed payload (they also set stream=true) — our reranker expects a single JSON with query(s) and documents as arrays of strings or objects; if the parser fails we fallback and sometimes return default scores (all 0.5) which looks wrong.

ajay: immediate customer workaround: remove the streaming headers and flag, set Content-Type: application/json, send a normal POST. Example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"Which of these is about payment?","documents":["Invoice overdue","New feature request","Billing question"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```

sam: long term - I filed a tiny infra ticket to harden error messages when Accept: text/event-stream is present so we return a clear 422 explaining rerank doesn't support streaming and pointing to docs. Also we should detect "stream":true in body and return 400 with helpful hint. Ticket: INF-4472

maria: customer tried the non-streaming curl and confirms success. pasted response:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "scores": [0.92, 0.12, 0.88],
  "order": [0,2,1]
}
```

maria: closing loop with customer. I'll note the fix and link INF-4472. Thanks :thumbsup:
